title: Night of shifting timelines in an LA Airbnb

tellings.quote: mantra I'm telling myself. I get in the shower and I'm kind of like trying to wind down and I hear that voice say, "Timelines

plain: One night in 2024 or 2025, in an Airbnb in Los Angeles, a voice told him "Timelines" as reality seemed to shift around him, says Brent Friedman, a Hollywood writer who says it happened to him. He tells Michels he was in the shower, trying to wind down and repeating a calming mantra, when he heard the voice say the word. He tells it as a sign that something was reaching him and showing him more than one version of events.
